method: Same highest display-roof elevation versus exact extrema of rendered 5 m triangles within each unchanged official footprint, 0.1 m tolerance. Detailed model tops are used where present; otherwise preserved outline/fallback top. This diagnoses conflicts, not every roof-face occlusion.
